description: Weekend-only schedule (GAL-1004): dependency PRs are batched into Saturday/Sunday so the weekday PR queue stays signal-heavy. Descendants carry the same schedule in their scaffolded renovate.json.

customManagers.description: Track the agent-skills caret pin with only the version digits as currentValue. rangeStrategy bump is ignored for custom managers (Renovate's getRangeStrategy returns null for them), so under a full ^range every 1.x release already satisfies it and no update is ever proposed; treating the digits as an exact version makes each release a real update, with the ^ preserved.
Bump npm dependency pins inside the copier-templated package.json.jinja
Track engines.node in package.json.jinja with the node datasource so it bumps in lockstep with template/.nvmrc (handled by the nvm manager).

packageRules.description: The generic regex manager also sees the agent-skills line with the full ^range as currentValue, which never updates; the dedicated manager above owns it, so skip this duplicate.

Our own package, delivered to every descendant only via copier update (they disable Renovate for it). Matched by its own regex manager so the floor is bumped on every release (the pin is a caret range and the template has no lockfile, so a plain range would never update; rangeStrategy bump does not apply to custom managers). minimumReleaseAge null and schedule at any time: we publish it ourselves, so the 2-week age gate and weekend schedule only delay new skills. automerge so it lands without a manual PR merge; release-please then cuts the patch.
Bump the kysely ecosystem as one PR. kysely 0.x minors are breaking and kysely-ctl/kysely-codegen pin a kysely range, so splitting them lands a kysely the migration CLI can't import.
Bump Node together everywhere — template/.nvmrc (nvm) and package.json.jinja engines.node (custom manager) — so dev/CI and the DO deploy version never drift apart.

Never offer PrimeVue majors for the package.json.jinja pin. v5 moved to a commercial license and the fleet is migrating off PrimeVue; descendants carry the same rule in their scaffolded renovate.json. Remove this rule if the migration is abandoned.
